title: Math: Number Patterns & Even/Odd 🚂
summary:
1. Even and Odd Numbers
• EVEN (Genap): Numbers that can be shared equally by 2. They always end in 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8.
• ODD (Ganjil): Numbers that have 1 left over when shared by 2. They always end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9.

2. Making Numbers with Digit Cards
If you have cards [ 3 ] and [ 8 ]:
• The largest number is 83 (Odd).
• The smallest number is 38 (Even).

3. Number Sequences
A number sequence is a list of numbers that follow a rule. We can count forwards or backwards by 1s, 2s, 5s, or 10s up to 100!
